instruction: Select all images containing a boat.

game.semantic_variant: Select all craft made to travel on water.
game.hint: Select all that apply. If you are unsure, use your best judgement.
game.explanation: Ordinary boats count, and so do the yacht standing on mechanical legs and the sailboat carrying a lighthouse: impossible, but still boats. The inflatable duck with an outboard motor and the floating picnic table are borderline cases, recorded without a verdict. The car, the picnic table on land and the wheelbarrow are not boats.

correct: Boats identified. Please do not rock them.
Correct. Every boat has been moored.
partial: Partially correct. A boat has drifted out of view.
Partially correct. Some boats sailed past you.
incorrect: Incorrect. The Department is all at sea.
Incorrect. Your harbour permit is under review.

selection_review.reason: Nine distinct, standardised images reviewed together at tile size: two ordinary boats (red-brown wooden rowing boat on calm water, shallow three-quarter view; black-and-white ferry crossing open water), two impossible boats (generated white yacht on four mechanical legs on a beach; generated sailboat carrying a red and white lighthouse), two borderline craft (generated inflatable duck float with an outboard motor; generated picnic table with an outboard motor afloat on a pond) and three non-members (red Fiat 500 in side view, weathered picnic table in a woodland clearing, galvanised wheelbarrow). The picnic table appears both afloat (borderline) and on land (non-member), so the setting rather than the object decides. Views, colours and settings vary within each role; generated images appear among targets and borderline cases alike. The varnished rowing boat, the white sloop and the motorised bathtub remain in the collection for later versions.
